issue.title: Retire staged_handoffs
issue.description: Stage plan handoffs for host completion instead of killing the runner.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The parent epic has retired the kill path and its acceptance checks are complete.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Plan proposals write a legacy pending marker and kill the agent runner.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Plan proposals stage a durable handoff record, then the host adopts it after finalizers settle.
